systems.name: 2.1 Enemy AI & Behaviour
systems.notes: Refine zombie pathfinding, attack patterns, and special abilities. Add variability: some zombies rush, some throw projectiles, some explode on death.
tasks: Implement multiple enemy types (grunt, spitter, charger, bloater)
Add enemy‑specific attack animations and timings
Flocking behaviour: enemies avoid clustering and surround player
Boss battles every 3rd wave with unique mechanics

systems.name: 2.2 Weapons & Combat Feel
systems.notes: Add more weapon variety beyond the starting pistol. Shotgun, assault rifle, grenade launcher, melee. Each with distinct feedback, reload, and ammo management.
tasks: Add weapon pickup system (ground loot or shop)
Add hit markers, damage numbers, and screen shake
Balance ammo drops and weapon damage per wave

systems.name: 2.3 Player Abilities & Progression
systems.notes: Introduce a simple upgrade system: earn points to buy temporary power‑ups (speed boost, double damage, healing totem). Add a dash or dodge mechanic.
tasks: Dash ability with cooldown and invulnerability frames
Power‑up station that spawns between waves

systems.name: 2.4 Wave Scaling & Pacing
systems.notes: Ensure wave difficulty scales smoothly with player count and wave number. Add mini‑bosses, increasing spawn rates, and environmental hazards.
tasks: Tune HP and speed multipliers per wave
Add random special wave events (fog, darkness, double enemies)
Implement grace period between waves for healing/ammo
